questions.question: Use highlight_path with path equal to Daily Quests, Player Wallet, Gear Enhance and use trace_node with node_name equal to Player Wallet and use color_flows with nodes equal to #e74c3c, color equal to #e74c3c in order to know How does the in-game currency flow through the game economy system? What are the primary sources and sinks of gold coins?

answer.value: The game economy shows a balanced currency circulation of approximately 50M gold/day. Primary income sources include Daily Quests (17M gold, 34%), Dungeon Drops (17M gold, 34%), and IAP Exchange (10M gold, 20%). The Player Wallet serves as the central hub with 39.5M total flow. Major gold sinks are Gear Enhance (16M, 32% of total sinks), Pet Training (9.5M, 19%), and Gem Synthesis (6M, 12%). The system includes fees at multiple stages: Enhance Fee (10M), Training Fee (6M), and Transaction Tax (3M, 6% of circulation). Bot Farming contributes only 1M gold (2%), indicating minimal automated farming impact. The economy maintains balance with income sources matching consumption patterns, ensuring sustainable player progression.

key_insights: Daily Quests and Dungeon Drops each contribute 34% of gold income
Gear Enhance is the largest gold sink at 32%
Player Wallet is central hub with 39.5M total flow
Bot Farming has minimal impact at only 2% of income
